68EC000 Computer

This site collects the design documents and datasheets for the 68EC000 computer. Each page records its revision and design status. Board layout and measurements on the assembled machine remain to be done. Schematics and PCB files are not published yet.

Claude and Codex were used to help format and put my ideas into the design documents.

CPU
MC68EC000FN10
Address space
16 MiB
Data bus
16-bit
Main RAM
4 MiB of TMS44400 FPM DRAM
Firmware
128 KiB in four AT28C256-15PU EEPROMs, always read-only
Video controller
CL-GD5428 VGA controller with its 16-bit byte lanes swapped for the MC68EC000's big-endian bus and 2 MiB of video RAM
Floppy controller
Intel 82077AA-1 using interrupt-driven programmed I/O
Floppy drives
Two Mitsumi D359M3D 3.5-inch, 1.44 MB drives on one twisted cable
Sound
Yamaha YMF262 OPL3, two YAC512 converters, stereo headphone amplifier, volume control, and 3.5 mm output
Parallel I/O and timer
MC68230P10 PI/T driving a bit-banged monitor DDC channel, a 34-pin user I/O header, and a 24-bit timer

Design Documents

Project documents
Document Status Contents
Memory Map Revision 1.2; address specification frozen Address ranges, I/O slots, boot overlay, peripheral registers, and DRAM organization.
Bus and Address Decode Revision 1.1 pre-layout design Bus cycles, address decoders, boot-overlay logic, worked decode examples, timing, and bus termination.
Clock and Reset Revision 1.1 pre-layout design 10 MHz clock, the DRAM and I/O clock buffers, and active-low reset generation.
Power Control Revision 1.0 pre-layout design Front-panel power-button timing, power-state logic, relay drive, and switched +5 V and +12 V rails.
Interrupts Revision 1.1 pre-layout design Priority encoding, acknowledge decode, autovector and the MFP and PI/T vectors, and spurious-interrupt handling.
System Control Revision 1.0 Boot-overlay and debug-register behavior.
Debug Display Revision 1.0 pre-layout design Two-digit hexadecimal seven-segment display.
DRAM Revision 1.0 pre-layout design DRAM organization, discrete controller, refresh, initialization, timing, electrical checks, and assembled-board acceptance.
Firmware ROM Revision 1.0 pre-layout design AT28C256 organization, read-only wiring, and completion timing.
MC68901 MFP Revision 1.0 pre-layout design Bus interface, register map, timers, interrupt routing, bidirectional PS/2 keyboard, and MAX232 RS-232 port.
Floppy Controller Revision 1.0 pre-layout design Intel 82077AA-1 bus adapter, programmed-I/O interface, and two Mitsumi D359M3D drives.
CL-GD5428 VGA Revision 1.0 pre-layout design ISA-mode bus adapter, swapped byte lanes, linear 2 MiB aperture, display memory, configuration EEPROM, dedicated clock, DE-15 output, and the monitor DDC channel.
YMF262 OPL3 Revision 1.0 pre-layout design FM-synthesis bus adapter, dedicated clock, reset, two YAC512 converters, stereo mixing, volume control, and headphone output.
MC6850 MIDI Revision 1.0 pre-layout design MC6850 bus adapter, register map, clocking, interrupts, and isolated MIDI IN, OUT, and hardware THRU.
DS1285 RTC Revision 1.0 pre-layout design Multiplexed-bus adapter, register map, timing, crystal, battery, reset, firmware access rules, and interrupt wiring.
MC68230 PI/T Revision 1.0 pre-layout design Bus connection, register map, bit-banged monitor DDC channel, user I/O header, 24-bit timer, and two vectored interrupt levels.
Expansion Slots Revision 1.0 pre-layout design Two front-loading DIN 41612 slots, fixed address windows, buffered bus interface, pinout, power, card rules, and example card.
